text: I've been thinking about renting a car for a weekend getaway for a while now, and I came across the Orsini Veloce. I'm really drawn to it and I think it would be perfect for what I have in mind. We would pick it up on April 6, 2027 at 12.00pm and bring it back on Wednesday 7 April 2027 at 6:00 pm. We'll actually be collecting it from your garage, by the way, I've driven by there a few times. I've attached my driving licence so you can verify everything.
